task.title: P6-181: Note owned-badge markup coupling and untested authed-badge coverage gap
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 10 — Hygiene and docs). Original id: P6-181. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-work-loop.md.

**Two small owned-badge markup and coverage notes** (was `P6-038f` + `P6-038g`): `catalog.rs:760`'s `ResultsList` moved its `ml-2` off the `Badge` onto a wrapper `<span>`, equivalent today only because `Badge` renders `inline-flex`; and `android-owned-badge-check.mjs` covers only the anonymous half by design (the dev proxy strips Cookie headers), so the authed on-device badge is never exercised — worth a comment saying so rather than a fix.
